content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** § 12.4 (p0051) is the sole non-solicitation provision and fails the fallback on every material term — one-way against Customer, eighteen months from termination, all Vendor personnel employed at any time, "engage" (an effective no-hire), and no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-outs. It also conflicts with § 12.3's acknowledgement that Customer has made no no-hire commitment. I proposed the preferred position via a single surgical replacement removing the restriction, with the narrow mutual fallback offered in the comment.
